title: Spyglass: Officially Launched!
summary: We are excited to announce the full public release of Spyglass, empowering you with powerful new ways to explore and understand your data.

title: Full Control Over Your Files and Images
summary: Now, effortlessly manage and customize all your files, from images to documents, directly within the editor with new tools for uploading, organizing, and controlling their display.

title: Our Public Product Roadmap
summary: We're thrilled to unveil our new public roadmap, providing a clear view of our completed features, upcoming developments, and future plans!

title: Enhanced Checkbox Experience
summary: Enjoy a significantly improved checkbox experience with larger, more clickable, and easily draggable checkboxes that seamlessly integrate with our modern interface.

title: Enhanced Collaboration in Your Editor
summary: Experience a significantly improved collaboration environment, designed to make teamwork effortless and more productive than ever before.

title: Effortless Collaboration and Discovery
summary: We've made it simpler than ever to discover and collaborate on shared items, empowering seamless teamwork and productivity.

title: Noeko: Now Open Source!
summary: Noeko is now fully open-source, empowering you with maximum control, transparency, and direct involvement in shaping the project's future.

title: Noeko: Now in Your Language
summary: We're making Noeko accessible to even more users around the world by introducing comprehensive support for a wide array of international languages.

title: Stunning New Themes and Visual Refresh
summary: Experience a fresh, polished look with our enhanced existing themes and explore a captivating collection of brand-new visual styles designed to elevate your personal workspace.

title: Dynamic Knowledge Constellation
summary: Transform your knowledge exploration with an intelligent Constellation view, offering advanced filtering by tags, time, and shared items to seamlessly integrate into your workflows.

title: Precision Search & Curated Knowledge Collections
summary: Efficiently locate and organize your information by applying advanced filters and saving your tailored search results as personalized knowledge collections.

title: Visualize and Organize Your Connected Thoughts
summary: Effortlessly structure and visualize your thoughts with dynamic new options for displaying connected content, making your ideas more accessible and engaging.

title: Unlock Unprecedented Control with Noeko Self-Hosted & Premium Plans
summary: Soon, Noeko will offer versatile self-hosted deployment alongside premium cloud-hosted plans, providing enhanced control and features designed to elevate your productivity.

title: Perfectly Timed Greetings
summary: We're enhancing your experience by ensuring your homepage greeting always accurately reflects the current time of day, making every interaction feel perfectly tailored.

title: Bulk Tag Cleanup
summary: Clean up your lists faster by effortlessly unapplying tags from multiple items directly within your tag views, saving you time and clicks.

title: Expanded Content Sources
summary: Effortlessly bring in information from a wider variety of sources, including videos, websites, and text files, to enrich your knowledge base.
